text:
No option can be put forward yet, because neither the £20k MRR target nor the strict monthly-churn limit was successfully checked in this run.

- The comparison is modelled as robust under the changes tested, but it ranks outcomes by higher MRR without a recorded goal direction; the £20k/month threshold could not be aligned with the model’s MRR output.
- Monthly churn under **4%** was left unscored: this model derives churn from other factors rather than measuring it on a comparable scale.
- The most sensitive model input is the Pro subscriber base, an Olumi estimate rather than user evidence. Investigation priority is not established from this sensitivity alone.
